actions.name: READ_CUSTOMER_MARGIN
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated GET only. SELECT only for ERP, cost evidence, report and frozen snapshots. No DDL, SP, UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, cache refresh or financial confirmation. Preserve existing report calc and customer price fields. Keep EstQuantity/EstUnit separate from physical OutQuantity/OutUnit. All products, signed adjustments, source coverage and missing costs remain explicit. Strict WdetailKey receipt identity is opt-in for this analysis; legacy report defaults remain unchanged. Read exact purchase periods after real zero-stock anchor without global 12-subweek truncation. Native ROUND2 quantity evidence never fills missing acquisition cost.

actions.name: READ_MARGIN_RECONCILIATION
actions.sideEffect: Same authenticated GET and year/calendar validation with view=reconciliation; SELECT-only N/L/O diagnostics without cost reconstruction. Show current/prior category and total amounts, missing values, source times, actual observed scope and demonstrated current classification effects. Do not overwrite snapshots or infer historical causes from classification fingerprint alone.

crossYearFixture.description: Same ProdKey, CustKey and OrderWeek in 2025 and 2026 cannot mix. Each comparison period is explicitly year-scoped; previous-year period is chosen from actual calendar, never an unconditional week52.

dnspyEvidence.source: Fresh dnSpy.Console.exe FormSalesView/FormStockView against installed Nenova.exe plus prior FormWarehouseView/ClassShipmentDetail and SELECT-only SQL probes; existing golden FormProfitReport/ProfitInventoryCycleEvidence; separate management analysis, never an EXE ledger valuation change.
